about: The fix round around the desk (review-r2 RC-01 to RC-18, review-r3 RA-04): each defect fixed has a scenario that fails without the fix, reached the way a user reaches it (scenarios/37-fix-chrome.mjs).

scenarios.why: RC-02: a revision saved here, deleted or renamed, stays so in the list, in storage and after a reload; Undo and Redo say nothing is taken.
RC-02: a revision exported, deleted, imported, renamed and deleted stays deleted.
RC-02 and C-09: deletes, renames and saves in two tabs, in both orders, reach the other tab and never bring back a record.

RC-08 and C-09: a tab keeps its own desk when another writes, offers the newer one (once), reloads with its own, Use that desk is one step Undo takes back (tier included); a tab that only looks writes nothing.
RA-04 and RC-09: the Drafts list is the page's one popover and a layer: Ctrl+Z says close it first, Ctrl+Enter starts no run, Shift+Tab closes it, a tile's moves take its place, one Escape closes it.
RC-03: the row menu's arrows move one item, Tab past it closes it, Escape closes it and gives focus back to its button.
RC-09: Ctrl+Enter in the save row's name field saves, as its Enter does, and starts no run.
RC-05: the song menu closed by a click outside gives focus back to its button.
RC-06: the engine panel is a layer: F9 closes it as the picker opens, Escape lands on Engine; its own Escape still closes it.
RC-07: Redo of an add puts focus on the tile's grip.
RC-10: at 360 on touch, a module added from the Modules drawer is in view with focus on its grip.
RC-11 (Q-14): the focused tile keeps its place on screen through Alt+3 and Alt+1.
RC-13: an empty Modules filter says so, with Clear the filter.
RC-14: the hidden Lab modules are named in the desk's order.
RC-15: a toast showing before a modal opens is not in its Tab cycle.
RC-16: a prompt tool's Undo tooltip ends with "Anything else you did since stays as it is."
RC-17: an imported file whose workflow cannot be read says where the revision went; no markup runs.
RC-01: the navigation shows each page's stand-in and comes back; aria-current and focus follow; Latest's Open the Library goes there.
RC-04: with no room above or below and no page to move, the song menu stands beside its card, clear of the card and the go bar.
